goal: Goal 发布: converge the repeatedly Owner-proven DSH Vehicle Pet fixed-ref production upgrade flow into one repository-local release helper (default read-only, exact-40-hex target, preflight/dry-run/apply/rollback/verify, stale-local-main-safe, evidence-branch-safe) plus a Controlled Runbook, deterministic tests, and a disposable DSH end-to-end proof.
